title: Inkybot Metrics
description: Usage, maging performance, feature engagement, and reliability

queries.query: SELECT count(*) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric = 'session_started'
SELECT count(distinct session_id) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric = 'session_started'
SELECT avg(uptime_ms) / 60000.0 as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric = 'session_ended'
SELECT count(*) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric IS NOT NULL

SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as x_axis_1, count(*) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric = 'session_started' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1 ASC

panels.title: Activity by User
panels.description: Which users generate the most events?

queries.query: SELECT user_email as x_axis_1, count(*) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric IS NOT NULL AND user_email IS NOT NULL GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC

panels.title: Events by Category Over Time
panels.description: Metric events broken down by category

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as x_axis_1, count(*) as y_axis_1, CASE WHEN metric LIKE 'run_%' THEN 'maging' WHEN metric LIKE 'ui_%' THEN 'ui' WHEN metric LIKE 'session_%' THEN 'session' ELSE 'other' END as breakdown_1 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric IS NOT NULL GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1 ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN uptime_ms < 60000 THEN '< 1 min' WHEN uptime_ms < 300000 THEN '1-5 min' WHEN uptime_ms < 900000 THEN '5-15 min' WHEN uptime_ms < 1800000 THEN '15-30 min' WHEN uptime_ms < 3600000 THEN '30-60 min' ELSE '60+ min' END as x_axis_1, count(*) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric = 'session_ended' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC
SELECT count(*) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric = 'run_started'
SELECT count(*) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric = 'combine_executed'
SELECT avg(total_combines) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric = 'run_finished' AND had_any_combine = true
SELECT avg(duration_ms) / 60000.0 as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric = 'run_finished' AND had_any_combine = true

panels.title: Run Outcomes
panels.description: Why do maging runs end? (finished, manual_stop, out_of_runes, no_item_found, item_mismatch, item_changed, error, etc.)

queries.query: SELECT reason as x_axis_1, count(*) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric = 'run_finished' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC

panels.title: Combines by Stat
panels.description: Which stats are being maged most?

queries.query: SELECT stat as x_axis_1, count(*) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric = 'combine_executed' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN is_exo = true THEN 'Exo' ELSE 'Normal' END as x_axis_1, count(*) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric = 'combine_executed' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC

SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as x_axis_1, count(*) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric = 'run_started' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1 ASC
SELECT rune_type as x_axis_1, count(*) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric = 'combine_executed' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC

SELECT _timestamp as x_axis_1, run_id as x_axis_2, reason as x_axis_3, total_combines as x_axis_4, duration_ms as x_axis_5 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric = 'run_finished' ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: All UI Actions (Top 20)
panels.description: Which buttons/features do users interact with most?

queries.query: SELECT metric as x_axis_1, count(*) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric LIKE 'ui_%' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Forms Opened
panels.description: How deep into the UI do users go?

queries.query: SELECT metric as x_axis_1, count(*) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric IN ('ui_setup_form_opened', 'ui_config_form_opened', 'ui_statistics_form_opened', 'ui_hall_of_fame_opened', 'ui_help_opened', 'ui_mage_queue_opened') GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC

panels.title: Config Changes by Type
panels.description: What config-related actions do users take?

queries.query: SELECT metric as x_axis_1, count(*) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric IN ('ui_config_modified', 'ui_config_checkbox_toggled', 'ui_custom_script_changed', 'ui_custom_script_reset', 'ui_config_form_advanced_toggled', 'ui_auto_shutdown_changed') GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC

panels.title: Preset Activity (Save / Load / Delete)
panels.description: Are people using the preset system?

queries.query: SELECT metric as x_axis_1, count(*) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric IN ('ui_preset_saved', 'ui_preset_loaded', 'ui_preset_deleted') GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC

panels.title: Advanced Mode Toggles
panels.description: How many users discover advanced features?

queries.query: SELECT count(*) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric IN ('ui_config_form_advanced_toggled', 'ui_setup_form_advanced_toggled')
SELECT count(*) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric IN ('ui_custom_script_changed', 'ui_custom_script_reset')

panels.title: Queue Operations
panels.description: Are people using the mage queue?

queries.query: SELECT metric as x_axis_1, count(*) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric IN ('ui_queue_item_added', 'ui_queue_item_removed', 'ui_queue_cleared', 'ui_mage_queue_opened') GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as x_axis_1, count(*) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric LIKE 'ui_%' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1 ASC
SELECT count(*) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric = 'run_error'
SELECT count(*) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric = 'run_warning'
SELECT count(*) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric = 'run_started'
SELECT count(distinct run_id) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric = 'run_error'

SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as x_axis_1, count(*) as y_axis_1, metric as breakdown_1 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric IN ('run_error', 'run_warning') GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1 ASC
SELECT error_type as x_axis_1, count(*) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric = 'run_error' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC
SELECT warning_type as x_axis_1, count(*) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric = 'run_warning' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC

SELECT _timestamp as x_axis_1, run_id as x_axis_2, error_type as x_axis_3, error_message as x_axis_4 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric = 'run_error' ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT _timestamp as x_axis_1, run_id as x_axis_2, warning_type as x_axis_3, warning_message as x_axis_4 FROM "default" WHERE ('$user_email' = '' OR user_email = '$user_email') AND metric = 'run_warning' ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 25
